notes: Known Pipedream files are a OneDrive uploader and calendar/email proxy, not the full assistant workflow source.

Local orchestrator equivalents are reused through the phone bridge; no Render booking implementation is being re-ported. 31 current tools mapped with explicit partials/gaps; runtime parity remains unproven.

One generic Comet-primary/public-Stagehand-fallback adapter supplies site-neutral preview and confirmed single-step routing. Runtime remains dry-run-only. Resy preview gap maps in source; Resy confirmation remains partial. All original 8 gaps and 8 partials have explicit delta entries.
